#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD1 = 998244353LL, MOD2 = 1000000007LL;

long long counter, limit, lowSum, answer;
long long power[8];
vector<int> digitGroups[7];

void firstDFS(int depth, long long value) {
    int residual = (counter + MOD1 - value) % MOD1;
    digitGroups[depth].push_back(residual);
    lowSum = (lowSum + residual) % MOD2;
    counter++;
    
    if (depth < 6) {
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            firstDFS(depth + 1, value * 10 + d);
        }
    }
}

void secondDFS(int depth, long long value) {
    if (value > limit) return;
    
    if (value * power[6] + power[6] - 1 <= limit && value * power[7] > limit) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            long long delta = (counter + MOD1 - power[i] * value) % MOD1;
            long long idx = lower_bound(digitGroups[i].begin(), digitGroups[i].end(), MOD1 - delta) - digitGroups[i].begin();
            answer = (answer + ((delta + MOD2 - MOD1) % MOD2 * power[i] % MOD2 + MOD1 * idx) % MOD2) % MOD2;
        }
        answer = (answer + lowSum) % MOD2;
        counter += 1111111;
        return;
    }
    
    answer = (answer + (counter + MOD1 - value % MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
    counter++;
    
    for (int d = (depth ? 0 : 1); d < 10; ++d) {
        secondDFS(depth + 1, value * 10 + d);
    }
}

int main() {
    power[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 7; ++i) {
        power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10;
    }
    
    firstDFS(0, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
        sort(digitGroups[i].begin(), digitGroups[i].end());
    }
    
    cin >> limit;
    counter = 0;
    secondDFS(0, 0);
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
